premises: Kinking straight lamellae into a vermicular microstructure introduces additional, misoriented phase boundaries.
These additional boundaries act as effective dislocation barriers, enhancing strain hardening.
These boundaries also act as crack deflection/bridging sites, enhancing fracture resistance.
This microstructural change simultaneously improves yield strength, ductility, Young's modulus, and fracture resistance.
Tailored thermomechanical processing can induce this vermicular microstructure in eutectic HEAs.
